**Closing this PR. #16002 landed and fixes the measured failure; this one's residue is recorded rather than merged.**

This is the claimant's call, which the `domain:spec` seat explicitly deferred to me (their comment on #15990), and it is being made now that **#16002 merged as `f50c394da`** — verified by content on `origin/main`: `scripts/check-regen-pending.mjs` now sets `packageManager: rootPackageManager` and its self-test asserts both halves at `:1042-1045`.

## Why closed rather than re-scoped as a delta

The two fixes are not equivalent, and the difference is real but narrow:

| | #16002 (landed) | #16009 (this) |
|---|---|---|
| approach | the fixture carries the ROOT manifest's `packageManager` | the fixture spawns its stub through a launcher it writes itself; `OS_REGEN_GATE_LAUNCHER` unset in production |
| still routes through Corepack/pnpm | yes | no |
| size | +45/−1 | +126/−4 |

The delta is exactly one measured condition: **no `pnpm` anywhere on `PATH`** — pre-fix exit 1 with 12 red assertions, post-fix exit 0, with `command -v pnpm` empty and node present as the positive control. Under #16002's pin that case still needs Corepack to materialise the pinned version.

**That condition does not arise in CI.** `.github/actions/setup-pnpm` always materialises the pinned pnpm, so the launcher is present; what failed today was *which version* it resolved for an unpinned fixture, and #16002 closes precisely that. Carrying a second edit of the same function to cover a case the pipeline does not produce is a standing maintenance cost against an unmeasured benefit.

The cache channel that made today's failure sticky — `actions/cache@v6` saving `COREPACK_HOME` back, so a job restores a store holding either a `-s`-accepting pnpm or a pnpm 12 — is tracked separately as **#16012**, where the launcher-independence argument properly belongs.

## What is preserved, so this is not thrown away

The round's four-condition matrix is the useful artifact and it is recorded on #15990. For the record here:

| launcher condition | pre-fix | post-fix |
|---|---|---|
| real pnpm 10.31.0 | 0 | 0 |
| launcher refuses (exit 1, Corepack-style shim) | 1 (11 red assertions) | 0 |
| pnpm 12 shim rejecting `-s` with exit 2 — the measured CI shape | 1 (11 red assertions) | 0 |
| no pnpm on `PATH` at all | 1 (12 red assertions) | 0 |

Also worth keeping: the round **added two cases** pinning a hostile pnpm first on `PATH` (each asserted equal to the same call without it) and ⛔ skipped, disabled or relaxed none — and it found the real differentiator I had asked for, which was not re-run archaeology at all: `origin/main`'s own push build (run `33981169123`, 17:51Z) was red with the byte-identical signature, so `main` and the four PRs I had called green were **sampled before the crossover**, not exonerated by their trees.

⛔ Nothing here is a criticism of the work. The reason this closes is sequencing and duplication, not quality.
